description: Charlotte Terrace Business Centre" is a modern co-working building with 8 individual serviced office units. The offices come fully inclusive of all bills and come in a range of sizes. The office developments have a number of different businesses renting the spaces creating a really nice friendly vibe. The building has several shared amenities including a stunning kitchen and dining area for the offices to enjoy along with a modern shower room and toilet facilities. On the GF of the building is a successful bar called “The Cask Lounge” which is a long-standing tenant of the building. Charlotte Terrace business centre is in a prime town centre location directly opposite the town hall. A short walk into town you find all the coffee shops and amenities. We are just up the road from the metro station which has a direct line into Newcastle city centre.
